# forumulate_collection (Resource)

A collection: the container a docs space groups its pages into, and the navigation tree readers see. Collections nest (`parent_id`), carry a landing page (`description`, `cover_url`, `seo`) and decide how the sidebar treats them (`nav`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "forumulate_collection" "guides" {
  space_id    = forumulate_space.docs.id
  name        = "Guides"
  slug        = "guides"
  description = "Start here."

  nav = {
    icon      = "book"
    collapsed = false
    hub_cards = true
  }

  seo = {
    title = "Guides"
    index = "index"
  }

  translations = {
    es = { name = "Guías", description = "Empieza aquí." }
  }
}

resource "forumulate_collection" "api" {
  space_id  = forumulate_space.docs.id
  name      = "API"
  parent_id = forumulate_collection.guides.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The collection's name, 1 to 160 characters.
- `space_id` (String) The docs space (its id or slug). Changing it replaces the collection.

### Optional

- `cover_url` (String) A banner above the landing page: an uploaded path or an http(s) URL, up to 2048 characters.
- `description` (String) The landing page's subtitle and meta description, up to 500 characters.
- `nav` (Attributes) How the reader's sidebar treats this collection. Only the attributes you set are managed; removing one returns it to the theme's default. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nav))
- `parent_id` (String) The parent collection's id; leave out for a top-level collection.
- `seo` (Attributes) Search-result overrides for the landing page. Replaced whole when changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--seo))
- `slug` (String) The collection's address segment (1 to 80 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens). Derived from the name when left out.
- `translations` (Attributes Map) The collection's name and description in other languages. Keyed by language code (`es`, `pt-br`). Replaced whole when changed; remove the attribute to clear them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--translations))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The collection's id (a UUID).
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the space's default collection.

<a id="nestedatt--nav"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nav`

Optional:

- `audience_principals` (Set of String) Limit the collection to readers with one of these principals (up to 20).
- `audience_roles` (Set of String) Limit the collection to readers with one of these roles (up to 20).
- `back_style` (String) `link` or `title`: the way back out of an isolated collection.
- `collapsed` (Boolean) Start the group collapsed.
- `hub_cards` (Boolean) Draw the landing page as cards.
- `icon` (String) A named icon, or a custom icon (path, URL or emoji).
- `link_hub` (Boolean) Make the group's heading link to its landing page.
- `nav_scope` (String) `shared`, or `isolated` to show only this collection's pages in the sidebar.


<a id="nestedatt--seo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `seo`

Optional:

- `description` (String) The meta description, up to 320 characters.
- `index` (String) `auto` (indexed unless thin), `index` or `noindex`.
- `title` (String) The `<title>`, up to 120 characters.


<a id="nestedatt--translations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `translations`

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description in this language (up to 2000 characters).
- `name` (String) The name in this language (up to 200 characters).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import forumulate_collection.guides docs/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000
```
